list.name: segment
list.label: Segment
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT metric_json->>'segment' AS segment FROM metrics WHERE metric_json IS NOT NULL AND metric_json->>'segment' IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1;

list.name: project
list.label: Project
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT project FROM metrics WHERE project IS NOT NULL AND (CASE WHEN COALESCE('$segment','') = '' THEN TRUE ELSE metric_json->>'segment' = '$segment' END) ORDER BY 1;

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT project) FROM runs WHERE project IS NOT NULL;

WITH total AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT project) AS n FROM runs WHERE project IS NOT NULL), recent AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT project) AS n FROM runs WHERE project IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(finished_at, started_at) >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days') SELECT ROUND(100.0 * recent.n/NULLIF(total.n,0), 1) FROM total, recent;

WITH allp AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT project) AS n FROM runs WHERE project IS NOT NULL), cov AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT project) AS n FROM metrics WHERE metric_key='overall_maturity_score' AND (CASE WHEN COALESCE('$segment','') = '' THEN TRUE ELSE metric_json->>'segment' = '$segment' END)) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * cov.n/NULLIF(allp.n,0), 1) FROM allp, cov;

SELECT COALESCE(project,'Unknown') AS project, MAX(COALESCE(finished_at, started_at)) AS last_seen FROM runs GROUP BY COALESCE(project,'Unknown') HAVING MAX(COALESCE(finished_at, started_at)) < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' ORDER BY last_seen;
